name: Leadership In The Church
overview: Scripture emphasizes the solemn responsibility entrusted to church leaders, who are appointed by the Holy Spirit to shepherd and care for God's purchased flock with diligence and faithfulness. Believers are called to remember and obey these leaders, recognizing that they watch over their souls and must give an account with joy rather than grief. At the same time, the warning against many becoming teachers highlights the serious accountability church leaders face, underscoring the need for careful, godly leadership within the church.
